note: City of Beatrice campground in Chautauqua Park, south Beatrice, 3.5 blocks east of US 77 at Grable St, in a loop ~90-120 m from the Big Blue River behind trees. 20 full-hookup sites (3 pull-through); hot showers, dump station. Self-register at the site; checkout 1 pm. Closed in winter (no dates posted). --Claude
